consumer_complaint_narrative: I noticed an unauthorized charge of $120.00 on my credit card statement from an unknown vendor. I contacted customer service immediately, but they refused to remove it or investigate properly. This is completely unacceptable and fraudulent.

I made my monthly mortgage payment three days before the due date through their online portal. However, they processed it late and charged me a $50 late fee. I have proof of submission but they won't refund it.

issue: Attempts to collect debt not owed
consumer_complaint_narrative: A third-party debt collector has been calling my phone multiple times a day demanding payment for a debt that I paid off and settled years ago. They refuse to provide validation of the debt despite my repeated requests.

My credit report shows that I have an active delinquent account with a major retailer, which is incorrect as this account was closed in good standing five years ago. I've disputed this multiple times with no success.

My bank charged me an overdraft fee even though my account balance never went below zero. They claim a pending transaction caused it, but my actual available balance remained positive at all times. They won't refund the fee.

issue: Dealing with your lender or servicer
consumer_complaint_narrative: I applied for an income-driven repayment plan months ago. My servicer has repeatedly delayed processing my application, causing me to miss deadlines and potentially forcing me into default. Their customer support is unhelpful.

I have been trying to make a principal-only payment on my auto loan for weeks, but the loan servicer's online portal does not allow it, and their phone agents insist all extra funds must go to next month's payment interest.

issue: Money was not available when promised
consumer_complaint_narrative: I sent money to my sister using an instant transfer service, but the funds were held for over a week with no explanation. Both of our accounts are fully verified, and their support team kept giving us generic answers.

My prepaid card issuer deducted a $15 'inactivity fee' from my account balance, despite the fact that I had made several purchases with the card in the last thirty days. Their terms did not clearly list this fee.

I requested a loan modification due to temporary financial hardship. The bank lost my documentation three separate times, forcing me to resubmit personal financial data while they threatened foreclosure proceedings.

My store credit card agreement specified a 0% introductory APR on purchases for the first six months. However, I was charged interest on my very first statement. Customer service admitted the error but hasn't fixed it.

I was contacted by a debt collector regarding a medical bill I had never received from the hospital. They reported it to credit bureaus before even mailing me a validation letter, severely damaging my credit score.

I filed a formal dispute regarding a fraudulent account on my credit report. The credit bureau took over 45 days to respond, exceeding the legal 30-day limit, and ultimately verified the fraudulent account as accurate.

The bank advertised a high-yield savings account rate, but lowered my rate significantly immediately after I deposited a large sum of money. There was no prior notification or clear disclosure about variable rate thresholds.

I have made 36 consecutive on-time payments on my private student loan and met all eligibility criteria for a co-signer release. However, the lender keeps finding technical excuses to deny my release application.

issue: Problems at the end of the lease
consumer_complaint_narrative: Upon returning my leased vehicle in perfect condition, the dealer charged me thousands of dollars for 'excessive wear and tear' on minor cosmetic issues that should be covered under standard wear guidelines.

I completed an international wire transfer. The receiving bank received significantly less than the guaranteed amount because the sender bank converted the currency at a highly unfavorable rate that wasn't disclosed.

I requested to close my credit card account and received confirmation. However, the account remains open on my credit report, and they recently billed me an annual fee on the closed account. They won't resolve it.

issue: Attempts to collect debt not owed
sub_issue: Debt is result of identity theft
consumer_complaint_narrative: I am being harassed by a collection agency for an unpaid phone lease that was opened in my name by an identity thief. I provided a police report and FTC affidavit, but the collector continues to report it and call me.

A car dealership ran my credit report and did a hard inquiry without my written permission or authorization. I was only visiting to look at prices and specifically told them not to run a credit check.
